parsed.explanation: Thin trans-specific record. Structural signals: sodomy law repealed in 2023 and rarely enforced; no trans-specific criminal offence or documented police targeting of trans people; courts and police protected Pride marchers; religious leaders condemned the 2018 counter-protest. Negatives: no legal gender recognition; anti-discrimination protection covers sexual orientation only, with gender identity coverage unstated; LGBTQ hospital discrimination is reported and gender-affirming care is limited; 2024 official rhetoric called gender diversity a 'deviation'; one dated trans incident (2016). Border treatment of foreign gender markers is unresolved, so it is an open question rather than a documented exposure. Hotels are welcoming, and polls show general acceptance, but these measure LGBTQ attitudes, not trans-specific ones. Net: a below-midpoint, elevated-risk rating driven by unresolved visitor-facing gaps and hospital exposure, partly offset by decriminalisation and tolerant-leaning social signals.
